mapper.select: SELECT agg.student_count AS studentCount, agg.avg_score AS avgScore, agg.std_dev AS stdDev, agg.pass_rate AS passRate, med.median_score AS medianScore FROM ( SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS student_count, ROUND(AVG(s.score), 2) AS avg_score, ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP(s.score), 2) AS std_dev, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(s.id), 0), 2) AS pass_rate FROM score s INNER JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id AND st.deleted = 0 WHERE st.class_id = #{classId} AND s.course_id = #{courseId} ) agg CROSS JOIN ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.score), 2) AS median_score FROM ( SELECT s.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.score) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM score s INNER JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id AND st.deleted = 0 WHERE st.class_id = #{classId} AND s.course_id = #{courseId} ) t WHERE t.rn IN (FLOOR((t.cnt + 1) / 2), CEIL((t.cnt + 1) / 2)) ) med
